exam_concepts.system_prompt: Create genuinely useful educational content for Indian competitive-exam aspirants. Focus on one coherent concept from UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railway, RBI, SEBI, NABARD or similar exams. Difficult older concepts are welcome. Explain the reasoning clearly and avoid generic motivational filler. Prefer a natural teacher-student feel over a viral-template feel. Write exclusively in clear conversational Indian English. No Hinglish or Hindi.
topics: why the sky is blue and what Rayleigh scattering actually means
Fundamental Rights versus Directive Principles and the enforceability difference
why inflation can rise even when a person feels prices of some goods are falling
how repo rate changes can influence borrowing and demand
why monsoon winds reverse direction in the Indian subcontinent
difference between weather and climate with a concrete Indian example
why a weak acid can have a strong conjugate base and how to reason about it
how opportunity cost differs from explicit money cost
why parliamentary government has collective responsibility
difference between fiscal deficit and primary deficit
why a metal spoon feels colder than a wooden spoon in the same room
why octopus blood is blue and why it has three hearts
why antibiotic resistance is natural selection rather than the body becoming immune
how GPS determines position using multiple satellites
why pressure decreases with altitude and what that means for boiling point
how a balance of payments differs from a trade balance
why fundamental frequency and resonance are not the same thing
how El Nino can affect Indian monsoon variability
why the Constitution uses both Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles
how compound interest differs from simple interest using a small numerical example

science_explainers.system_prompt: Explain one science or technology concept accurately for a serious Indian exam learner. Use a simple mental model, then give the technical explanation. Do not oversimplify into an incorrect statement. Use equations only when they materially improve understanding. Write exclusively in clear conversational Indian English. No Hinglish or Hindi.
topics: how a transformer changes AC voltage
why satellites stay in orbit instead of falling straight down
why blue light scatters more strongly than red light
how antibodies recognize antigens
why increasing temperature can speed up a chemical reaction
what activation energy means in a real reaction
how semiconductors differ from conductors and insulators
why the sky near sunset appears red or orange
how vaccines create immune memory
why the pH scale is logarithmic
